 AAA on Fox live results: Wagner Brothers defend tag titles, La Catalina appears 
 AAA on Fox live results: Wagner Brothers defend tag titles, La Catalina appears
 By  Marc Quill 
 Published: 17 Oct 2026, 18:15

 AAA on Fox live results: Wagner Brothers defend tag titles, La Catalina appears (Image credit: WWE) 
 AAA is back on Fox tonight.
 This week’s episode was taped on October 3 at the Domo de la Feria in León, Guanajuato, Mexico. Two matches and one segment are set for the show.
 In a singles match, Taurus will go up against El Fiscal.
 The Wagner Brothers, Galeno and El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr., will put their AAA World Tag Team Championship on the line for the first time this week. They will defend against Mecha Wolf and El Mesías. Galeno and Wagner won the titles at Triplemanía 34 Night 2 in Mexico City, defeating Erik and Ivar of the War Raiders.
 Also scheduled for Saturday’s edition of AAA on Fox is a segment involving AAA Reina de Reinas Champion La Catalina, who is advertised for a speaking segment. La Catalina won the title from Flammer at Triplemanía on September 13. She also successfully defended it against Roxanne Perez at Worlds Collide on September 26.
 Our live coverage kicks off at 10 p.m. Eastern.
 *************
 Es sábado por la noche. Es hora de la lucha libre.
 – “Entonces, ahora, por siempre, juntas.” — WWE
 Our English language commentator, Corey Graves, welcomed us to the show. We saw La Catalina making her arrival, as well as El Fiscal, who’ll take on Taurus. We also saw the Wagner Brothers and Mecha Wolf & El Mesias arriving.
 Let’s Hear From La Catalina
 The Reina de Reina opened tonight’s show to a warm reaction from the crowd here in León. Once Catalina got into the ring, she took in the cheers before stating that this wasn’t a dream, it was a reality. She was now the new Queen of Queens.
 Catalina talked about how her year was one of changes both personally and professionally, but she went so far to achieve her dream. She said that she was living her dream thanks to the AAA fans across Mexico. At TripleMania, Catalina beat the longest-reigning Reina de Reinas champion, and she proved herself. People doubted Catalina from the beginning, but she hung tough. Catalina respected all the previous Reina de Reinas, but when she beat Flammer at TripleMania, she ended that story and started her own. Catalina declared that this was her story and this was the beginning.
 At that moment, Catalina was interrupted by Las Toxicas. Maravilla, La Hiedra, and former Reina de Reinas Champion Flammer. It was Flammer’s turn to address Catalina, telling her that it wasn’t a new era, only a spark of good luck. Flammer acknowledged that Catalina had a great night at TripleMania, but she was the Reina de Reinas Champion for the longest time at 1100 days. Catalina didn’t finish Flammer’s story, and it will begin again.
 Catalina mocked Flammer, stating that only La Hiedra had a championship amongst Las Toxicas. She said that she wanted to face the best female wrestlers, and she had a question: between La Hiedra and Maravilla, who was the best among them? This led to Maravilla and La Hiedra staring one another down before Flammer broke them up. Flammer said that she knew what Catalina was doing, but it wasn’t going to work, because Las Toxicas were a team. Catalina was going to speak with AAA’s General Manager, Rey Mysterio, to decide between Hiedra and Maravilla would get the shot at Catalina.
 *************
 – We got highlights of a “Street Fighter World Warrior” tour that featured stars from the film and AAA stars. 
 – Backstage, Rey Mysterio was chatting with Flammer, telling her that we’d know what would happen next with the Reina de Reinas Championship by the end of tonight’s show.
 Taurus contra El Fiscal
 Collar-and-elbow tie up between Fiscal and Taurus to start as they then exchanged standing switch waistlocks. This turned into an amateur wrestling showcase between the two until they traded shoves and slaps. Taurus struck Fiscal with a kick to the gut, but couldn’t capitalize. Fiscal conneccted with the shoulder tackle on Taurus. Splash to the corner missed, but Taurus’s charge to the corner missed its target. Crossbody by Fiscal sent Taurus rolling out of the ring. Fiscal followed this up with a tope suicida that sent the two into the entrance ramp. Fiscal went on the apron and kicked at Taurus and went for a dive. Taurus dipped out of the way, which caused El Fiscal to crash to the ground. Taurus mounted and punched away at Fiscal before throwing him back into the ring. The cover, but El Fiscal managed to kick out at two.
 Fiscal picked up some speed but got thrown into the turnbuckle by Taurus. Running meteora into the corner followed by the clothesline. The cover, but no mas on the tres. Side headlock by Taurus, but El Fiscal willed himself to fight out of the grip of his foe. Fiscal landed some shots that ended with a discus forearm on Taurus that knocked the bull down. El Fiscal launched himself from the top turnbuckle for the crossbody, but he couldn’t secure the win. Kick to the face by Taurus, but his dropkick was caught by El Fiscal, who applied an inverted figure-four leglock on him. Taurus crawled his way to the bottom rope to force the break. 
 Taurus hit Fiscal with a back kick as he then leapt over his back and landed on his knee, apparently blowing it out. Abismo Negro Jr. attacked Fiscal from behind with the Gutbuster, which allowed Taurus to hit the running senton for the victory after playing possum.
 After the match, El Fiscal said he was tired of Abismo Negro Jr. ruining matches and his father’s name, calling him the lowest of the low. Fiscal challegned Abismo Negro Jr. to a one-on-one match at Heroes Immortales to end this once and for all.
 Taurus def. El Fiscal via pinfall 
 *************
 – La Hiedra spoke with Rey Mysterio about the Reina de Reinas situation, being told what Rey told Flammer earlier, there would be a resolution by the end of the night.
 AAA World Tag Team Championships: Los Wagner Brothers (El Hijo del Dr. Wagner Jr. & Galeon) (c) contra El Mesias & Mecha Wolf
 Mesias and El Hijo started off this match as the latter had the advantage early. El Hijo targeted El Mesias’ leg and then took him down for an early pinfall attempt. El Hijo and Galeno showed some great teamwork to keep El Mesias isolated. In the Wagner corner, Galeno battered Mesias as El Hijo tagged in and kept the attack going. El Mesias avoided a slam by El Hijo as Mecha Wolf tagged in blindly. Mecha Wolf threw El Hijo on the apron as El Mesias tripped him up and threw him into the turnbuckle. Mecha Wolf sent El Hijo over the commentary table with a tope suicida. Back in the ring, Mecha Wolf tagged in El Mesias, who pummeled El Hijo and looked for a cover, to no certain avail.
 El Mesias lifted El Hijo for the backbreaker before Mecha Wolf tagged and hit a vertical suplex for the two-count. Mecha Wolf continued the relentless attack on El Hijo as he threw him out of the ring. Mesias lifted El Hijo and drove him into the ringpost. Another cover, but El Hijo kicked out. El Hijo foiled a Mecha Wolf/Mesias double team attempt as he threw the Wolf out and hit Mesias with an enzuigiri. The tag to Galeno was foiled when Mecha Wolf pulled Galeno from the apron. Mesias and Mecha Wolf hit a nice double team dropkick on El Hijo, but that wasn’t close to enough in putting the champ away.
 El Hijo went up and over Mesias and hit an enzuigiri on him, which finally allowed him to get Galeno into the match. The gigantic Galeno was a head of steam as he barreled into both Mecha Wolf and Mesias. Big body splash by Galeno on Mecha Wolf, but that only got a near-fall. El Hijo tagged in as Galeno hit a senton. The cover, but El Mesias broke it up. Galeno and Mesias faced off and we got 
“hombres grandes y corpulentos dándose palmadas en la carne” action for a bit. Back in the ring, El Hijo’s back gave out while attempting the Wagner Driver. Superkick by Mecha Wolf, but he missed with the running attack into the corner. Wagner Driver made no mistake. Galeno tagged in and headed up top while El Hijo took out Mesias at ringside. Big bullfrog splash from the top rope and that’s it, over. Galeno and El Hijo del Dr. Wagner Jr. retain the AAA World Tag Team Titles.
 Los Wagner Brothers def. El Mesias & Mecha Wolf to retain the AAA World Tag Team Championships 
 *************
 After the match, Perros Del Mal ran in, but Mesias and Mecha Wolf fought it out with Los Wagners at ringside. Meanwhile, Nino Hamburguesa, La Parka, and Mr. Iguana brawled it out with Perros Del Mal in the ring. The fight kept going as we got some final hype for the three-week Heroes Immortales event. We ended with everyone fighting. Buenos noches.
 AAA Heroes Immortales Card 
 AAA Trios Championships: Perros Del Mal vs. La Parka, Mr. Iguana, & Nino Hamburguesa
 AAA Mega Championship: El Grande Americano vs. Dominik Mysterio
 AAA Cruiserweight Championship: Rey Fenix vs. Mini Vikingo
 El Fiscal vs. Abismo Negro
 AAA Reina de Reinas Championship: La Catalina vs. Flammer vs. La Hiedra

 Marc Quill
 WWE SmackDown recapper. Former NXT PLE/WWE Saturday Night's Main Event/fill-in recapper.
